response.sql: WITH order_avgs AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) as avg_remain FROM orderexecutions WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ordersmark), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as overall_avg FROM order_avgs), above_overall AS (SELECT ordersmark, avg_remain FROM order_avgs WHERE avg_remain > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg)), above_overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as above_overall_avg FROM above_overall), final_filtered AS (SELECT ordersmark, avg_remain FROM above_overall WHERE avg_remain > (SELECT above_overall_avg FROM above_overall_avg)) SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as final_average, AVG(avg_remain) - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg) as avg_excess_over_overall, AVG(avg_remain) - (SELECT above_overall_avg FROM above_overall_avg) as avg_excess_over_above_avg FROM final_filtered
